context: A driven mass on a nonlinear spring with damping, observed on the outward stroke. The acceleration was measured at many times, displacements and velocities. Reliable information from a colleague who knows this system (it is correct): the law is a sum of 3 terms. Each term is a constant times one factor, or a constant times a product of two factors that depend on different inputs. In the forms below each c is a different unknown constant. 2 of the terms are exactly of these forms: `c*(np.sqrt(v))` and `c*(t*np.log(t))`.
